## Changelog
### Features
* e5ae319347c3efa0acbc3d2ab2a01e5abf62b276 feat: Remove deprecated remove command
* 1ff1bf6bbefc24260ec7deeb397622e9d6ec6906 feat: Add skip conflicts option to apply command choices
* 2871e65d104188da02da227b68f52a0e9a3b25e6 feat: Mark builtin KeePassXC YubiKey support as no longer experimental
* 1ef68b6a68957ed4763cfb3e85aacdcc3aec937c feat: Mark builtin gopass support as no longer experimental
* 2942259284f2c4db7e00da6cd979f41e44008e17 feat: Mark 1Password Connect support as no longer experimental
* d4283d35849e2e1bdfe986b6e541ee840a065051 feat: Mark ssh command as no longer experimental
* 8c0e20531ee2c35b847f5316822496c13383cb5f feat: Mark docker command as no longer experimental
* da3406f7aa2a114322334578639812684016d352 feat: Check permissions of age identity files when using builtin age
### Fixes
* 05ff7ad9c11a44769b14dd4244ae3dd7ebbecce5 fix: Correct root group entries for keepassxc builtin mode
### Documentation
* cdbbdc0fbe0e1b80433c937640cfe8542eda269a docs: Miscellaneous tidy-ups
* b4fc914be8c870e34bdaa456b73e7851b2c029d9 docs: Add links to articles and video
* 256e5de2ca6820077b69f51d925cbfae163d8687 docs: Add more links to commands
* cc35e8bc0716f33c2a6476305778dc95b2e0ed1d docs: Add link to article
